author: ANTON
description: EUR-Lex — the EU's authoritative database of legislation, case-law, and treaties. Wave 1 Service Pack covering search and document retrieval.

rate_limits.notes: EUR-Lex requires a polite delay between requests. SPARQL endpoint at /eli/sparql is preferred for structured queries.

search.description: Free-text search across all EU legislation

search_by_celex.description: Fetch a specific document by its CELEX number (e.g. 32022R0858 for AMLR Implementing Reg).

steps.description: Direct navigation to the CELEX-keyed document
Wait for the document title to render

search_keyword.description: Free-text search EUR-Lex and return the first results page.

steps.description: Navigate to the quick-search results page

known_issues: Multi-language documents — default redirect is to English; URL must include /EN/ to force English
Some PDF-only documents return empty textTabContent — fall back to /PDF/ URL variant
Search results page uses lazy-loaded sections — may need additional scroll for >10 results

fallback_hints.search_input: If the primary selector breaks, look for any input within form#searchForm
fallback_hints.results_list: Result items are typically inside <div class='SearchResult'> or <article class='result'>. Look for elements containing CELEX numbers (regex: 3[0-9]{4}[A-Z][0-9]{4})
